en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside or bayfront scene with a long wooden bridge or pier leading to several waterfront buildings. Small rowboats are moored beside a floating structure on the water in the foreground. In the background are numerous tents arranged like a campground and several wooden houses and low buildings set against a forest. On the right margin there is printed location text at the top and large handwritten numbers in black and red ink beneath it.
